 Avalanche at Canadiens projected lineups
 By 
 NHL.com 
 @NHLMedia 
 November 14, 2026 
 Link copied 
 AVALANCHE (11-6-3) at CANADIENS (12-3-4) 
 7 p.m. ET; TVAS, SNE, ALT2, KTVD 
 Avalanche projected lineup 
 Artturi Lehkonen -- Brock Nelson -- Martin Necas
 Jaden Schwartz -- Nazem Kadri -- T.J. Hughes
 Gabriel Landeskog -- Nicolas Roy -- Gavin Brindley
 Parker Kelly -- Fedor Svechkov -- Logan O'Connor
 Devon Toews -- Sam Malinski
 Brett Kulak -- Noah Juulsen
 Alex Gagne -- Brent Burns
 Mackenzie Blackwood
 Scott Wedgewood
 Scratched: None 
 Injured: Nathan MacKinnon (lower body), Cale Makar (lower body), Zachary L'Heureux (upper body), Josh Manson (lower body) 
 Canadiens projected lineup 
 Cole Caufield -- Nick Suzuki -- Juraj Slafkovsky
 Zachary Bolduc -- Phillip Danault -- Alexandre Texier
 Florian Xhekaj -- Jake Evans -- Josh Anderson
 Alex Newhook -- Oliver Kapanen -- Kirby Dach
 Lane Hutson -- Noah Dobson
 Kaiden Guhle -- Mike Matheson
 Arber Xhekaj --Alexandre Carrier
 Jakub Dobes
 Jacob Fowler
 Scratched: Owen Beck, Adam Engstrom 
 Injured: Ivan Demidov (lower body), Chris Kreider (lower body), Samuel Montembeault (lower body) 
 Status report 
 MacKinnon, a center, will be out at least one month and Makar, a defenseman, will be out approximately two weeks; Avalanche coach Jared Bednar said Makar has been playing with a soft-tissue injury that caused him to leave a 4-3 overtime loss at the Ottawa Senators on Thursday. MacKinnon was also forced to leave that game in the second period. ... Each player missed the morning skate Thursday prior to being in the lineup at Ottawa. … Gagne will make his NHL debut alongside Burns, who will play in his 1,600th NHL game. … Kreider will be out 6-8 weeks after being injured during a 5-2 win at the Boston Bruins on Thursday; the forward left in the third period following an open-ice collision with Bruins forward Mikey Essimont. … Florian Xhekaj will enter the lineup after being a healthy scratch the past two games. … Matheson will be a game-time decision after returning to the lineup Thursday; the defenseman missed the previous six games because of a lower-body injury. … Engstrom, a defenseman, will play if Matheson cannot.
